name: Arena-Hard v2
intro: Arena-Hard v2 是 LMArena 从 Chatbot Arena 真实用户查询中构建的高难度开放式对话基准，包含 500 条通用高难提示和 250 条创意写作提示。官方流程缓存候选与参考模型回答，分别使用风格控制或双评判器集成进行成对比较，并以胜率及 bootstrap 置信区间发布结果。
build_method: Chatbot Arena 真实用户查询筛选, 高难与创意写作双分区, 成对 LLM 评判
metric: 成对胜率, Bootstrap 置信区间
task_type: 开放式对话, 指令跟随
eval_feature: LLM-as-a-judge, 长度与 Markdown 风格控制, 双评判器集成
scale: 750条提示（500条高难提示 + 250条创意写作提示）
build_method_en: Chatbot Arena real-user query curation, separate hard and creative-writing splits, pairwise LLM judging
eval_feature_en: LLM-as-a-judge, response-length and Markdown style control, two-judge ensemble
intro_en: Arena-Hard v2 is LMArena's difficult open-ended dialogue benchmark built from real Chatbot Arena user queries, with 500 general hard prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts. The official workflow caches candidate and reference answers, applies style-controlled or two-judge-ensemble pairwise evaluation, and reports win rates with bootstrap confidence intervals.
scale_en: 750 prompts (500 hard prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts)
metric_en: Pairwise win rate, bootstrap confidence interval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Arena-Hard-Auto paper arXiv:2406.11939 and the official Arena-Hard v2.0 repository workflow: fresh challenging Chatbot Arena queries; a 500-prompt hard split covering software, mathematics, and other real-world problems; a separate 250-prompt creative-writing split; cached candidate and reference-system answers; Gemini 2.5 as the official hard-split judge with GPT-4.1 as the fast stable alternative; response length and Markdown density as style-control features; independent GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.5 creative-writing judgments combined as an ensemble; candidate-better, tie, and reference-better pairwise outcomes; hard-split style-controlled aggregation; win rates with bootstrap confidence intervals; and separability plus agreement-with-human-preference quality checks.
